snippet.title: Oink Splash Party Demo - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Oink Splash Party Demo is OUT NOW on Steam!

Battle as Oinks for FREE and check out our latest gameplay trailer!
May your punches be strong and your belly flops be legendary!

Wishlist Oink Splash Party and get ready for Steam Next Fest, starting October 19!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4660200/Oink_Splash_Party/

Stay chaotic, stay Oinky! 🐽
